state.project: Cainhoy - Hamlin 115kV: Rebuild Line and Cainhoy – Hamlin 115 kV #2: Construct New 115 kV Line
state.description: Upgrade the 954 ACSR portion of the Cainhoy – Hamlin 115 kV line to B795 ACSR conductor, construct a new Cainhoy – Hamlin 115 kV #2 line, add terminals to Cainhoy and Hamlin sub to accommodate upgrades.
state.need: This project is required due to load growth in the Mount Pleasant area and to meet NERC TPL and internal DESC Planning criteria.

q.instructions: Does the stated project need contradict the project description?

criteria.true: The need talks about equipment or work that the description and title never mention (likely copied from another project).
criteria.false: The need is generic (load growth, reliability, end of life) or matches the described work.
